name: Thierry Dubois
bio:
Thierry's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the stands of the Spa-Francorchamps circuit, captivated by the roar of engines and the vibrant energy. After studying human resources management at the Université Libre de Bruxelles, he initially worked in a corporate environment but quickly felt the pull back to racing. He saw an opportunity to combine his HR expertise with his passion for motorsport, specifically drawn to the high-pressure, team-oriented world of rallycross. 

As HR Manager for Hansen World RX Team, Thierry focuses on fostering a positive and supportive work environment where individuals can thrive. He believes in fair practices, clear communication, and investing in team development, understanding that a happy and motivated team is a winning team. Thierry distinguishes himself by his ability to quickly adapt to the dynamic nature of motorsport, implementing innovative HR strategies that cater to the unique demands of the racing world, always with an ear to the ground for new talents.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Thierry is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Prefers to conduct interviews walking around the paddock to gauge candidates' reactions to the racing environment.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
